title: I Followed the Urgent-Care Clipboard After They Skipped My Wristband

parts.text: I got a wristband at 3:18 p.m. and watched three later bands go first. The clipboard on the wall said: BAND ORDER IS TRIAGE EXCEPT RED. Mine was yellow; theirs were yellow. I was forty-two, holding a wrist that actually hurt. I photographed the board and followed the clipboard to the charge. Charge replayed the skip. I went next. The later bands waited like time existed. Yellow, it turns out, is a number.

social.video_title: Three later yellow bands went first — Part 1/1
social.description: 3:18 wristband, a wall clipboard, a skip. Charge replayed it. Would you have sat quietly yellow?
